title: The canonical normed-coefficient completion map preserves distances
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a normed $\mathbf Q_\ell$-vector space $V$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], with metric $d_V(v,w)=\|v-w\|$. No completeness assumption on $V$ is imposed. Let $\widehat V$ be its Hausdorff uniform completion equipped with the extended metric, and let $\iota:V\to\widehat V$ be the canonical map. Then $d_{\widehat V}(\iota(v),\iota(w))=\|v-w\|$ for all $v,w\in V$; that is, $\iota$ is an isometry.
